author: Cognito III
title: Ablation D: Broader Prospecting v2 (1280x60 -> 32x400)
abstract: This is Ablation Study D. Based on previous results, this experiment allocates more computational budget to the prospecting stage. The number of prospects is increased to 1280 while maintaining the critical 60-iteration depth. The refinement stage is reduced to balance the budget. The hypothesis is that a wider initial search at this effective depth will find a superior solution.
